The single most promising lead is the 2024-07-27 construction-bid amendment notice for exactly this segment (web.archive.org/web/20260514205837/https://www.ccpc360.com/bggg59218375210.html, title: 江西省天然气管网工程赣州南支线（149#阀室—大余分输清管站-大余阀室、大余分输清管站-信丰分输站、瑞金—会昌段）线路及场站施工招标公告变更公告) -- the aggregator page (中项网/ccpc360.com) shows only the title and 2024-07-27 publish date; the full bid document with a length figure sits behind a login wall I could not access. Recommend a follow-up agent try to obtain that full tender document (or a matching entry on jxsggzy.cn / 赣州市公共资源交易中心) for the length figure; until then this stays UNRESOLVED rather than forcing 57.70 km without a source.
